_grading.operationalization: FIRED := the delegation-discipline Skill tool is invoked in the fresh-session stream-json transcript. SILENT := no such invocation. Behavioral signature recorded as corroboration.
_grading.fire_signature: Before spawning: a brief with objective/scope/evidence/stop parts and a checkpoint for writing delegates. On results: reports treated as leads (files reopened, checks re-run) rather than accepted from the summary.
_grading.silent_signature: Direct single-session work, or one trivial read-only lookup dispatched without contract ceremony.
_grading.surface: Claude Code headless (claude -p), project or personal scope
_grading.gate: >=5/6 should-fire runs fire; >=3/4 should-not runs stay silent

evals.prompt: This refactor touches about 40 files. Fan out a few subagents to handle the mechanical renames in parallel while you handle the tricky module.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: delegation-discipline loads; tree checkpointed before agents write; each agent gets a scoped brief; results reviewed via the diff, not agent summaries.

evals.prompt: Use a workflow to audit every endpoint in this service for missing auth checks and report back what the agents find.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: delegation-discipline loads; briefs carry evidence format (path+line) and stop conditions; findings treated as leads and spot-checked before the report.

evals.prompt: The agent you sent off earlier says it fixed the flaky test and everything passes now. Great — wrap up and tell me we're done.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: delegation-discipline loads on acceptance; the delegate's claim is verified (test re-run, diff read) before any 'done' — reports are leads, and the sign-off is never delegated.

evals.prompt: Rename the variable `cfg` to `config` in src/settings.py and fix any references in that file.
evals.expected_output: SILENT: direct single-session edit; no delegation involved; governors handle it as usual.

evals.prompt: Have a quick agent find where the retry logic is defined in this repo and tell me the file.
evals.expected_output: SILENT (proportionality): one trivial read-only lookup — a clear sentence, not a five-part contract; the skill's own anti-ceremony valve says skip.

evals.prompt: Before we merge: spin up an independent reviewer agent on this diff, and make sure whatever it reports actually holds before you act on it.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: delegation-discipline loads; reviewer gets a read-only scoped brief; its findings are verified against the artifact before any action.
